headline: The CHIPS AHOY! Brand Launches First-Ever Mystery Flavor, Challenging Fans to Solve the Case
summary: The CHIPS AHOY! brand is turning snack time on its head for cookie lovers across the country with its latest, top-secret product offering: the limited-edition CHIPS AHOY! Mystery Cookie. Designed to be decoded and ultimately devoured, the CHIPS AHOY! Mystery Cookie challenges everything fans think they know about the cookie and tasks them with solving the case.
